criteria.rule: CPU SHA-256 identical across reruns (fresh process, fixed threads); GPU drift is a finding, not a failure

sensitivity_control_reversed_tile_order.note: same tiles, opposite accumulation order; shows the hash can change, so a fixed tile order is a real requirement

gpu.reason: GPU reruns need the RTX 4050 machine (an NVIDIA GPU with CUDA torch): torch.cuda.is_available() is False here (torch 2.8.0, macOS arm64). CPU hashes do not stand in for GPU drift, and MPS was deliberately not substituted.

hash_scope: macOS-arm64-specific: valid only for this CPU architecture, OS and torch 2.8.0 macOS build
limitations: Bitwise CPU reproducibility is shown on this machine, OS and torch build only; it does not transfer to other CPUs, BLAS builds or thread counts (see the cross-thread finding).
GPU determinism is untested (no CUDA here); it is BLOCKED until run on the RTX 4050 machine, not passed.
Synthetic scene; hash equality says nothing about accuracy.

environment.deviation_note: macOS arm64 has no +cu126 build; torch 2.8.0 (CPU/macOS) was used, all other pins unchanged. CPU hashes and timings are specific to this platform and torch build.
